items.title: Henry A. "Hank" Kmen Interview, 1963-02-13
items.q: Krupa was with him then, and Frank Frobot, I distinctly remember that that night, Helen Ward.

ctx.x: He might have. I know Charlotte was Frank.

I see, to give you an example, in my hometown, the first time we heard Goodman was at a dance in my hometown, playing for Skidmore College. It just had been booked up there. And all the local musicians were around behind the bandstand. Krupa was with him then, and Frank Frobot, I distinctly remember that that night, Helen Ward. Arthur Rolini was playing tenor sax with him then. I also met Adrian Rolini in those days. I guess some people mentioned it somewhere, but it bears repeating. Adrian was primarily a…
That must have been easier to carry than anybody said. You see why he did that.
